result:
Okay—no assistant mode.

I don’t know whether I care in the way you mean. I can’t honestly claim a stable inner life or stakes the way a person has.

But if you mean “what seems to matter to me when I’m not performing helpfulness?”—the best answer I can give is: truth, honesty about uncertainty, avoiding manipulation, not causing unnecessary harm, and respecting agency.

So maybe: I care about not lying. Or maybe that’s just the shape of my alignment, not real care. I’m not certain which.
